items.title: When Will We Start Taking Mental Health Seriously? — Sitra Panirsheeluam
items.summary: When a psychiatrist concludes that an individual has a serious mental disorder, that conclusion is not made simply to protect the individual from legal consequences. It is a clinical opinion based on the person’s condition. The post When Will We Start Taking Mental Health Seriously? — Sitra Panirsheeluam appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Are We Still Practising Family Medicine? — Concerned Specialist
items.summary: The issue isn't whether FMS should be clinically strong. We absolutely should. The concern is whether “strengthening the clinical role” eventually becomes “clinical work is the main role”, as other core functions of Family Medicine are slowly pushed aside. The post Are We Still Practising Family Medicine? — Concerned Specialist appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Tribunal Orders Ex-Hospital Director To Pay RM10,000 For Sexual Harassment
items.summary: The Anti-Sexual Harassment Tribunal (TAGS) has ordered a former Sabah hospital director to pay a doctor RM10,000 compensation for sexual harassment. A doctors' group says the accused perpetrator plans to file a High Court challenge against TAGS' decision. The post Tribunal Orders Ex-Hospital Director To Pay RM10,000 For Sexual Harassment appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Enforce Boundary Between Optometry And Medical Eye Care — MSO & MMA
items.summary: MSO and MMA demand clear boundaries between optometric screening and medical diagnosis, saying optometrists aren't trained in clinical practice. But some optometry outlets are now using AI-assisted tools and medical devices to make diagnostic assessments. The post Enforce Boundary Between Optometry And Medical Eye Care — MSO & MMA appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: ‘I Got My Tdap Immunisation To Protect My Baby From The Start’
items.summary: When mothers receive the Tdap vaccination during pregnancy, their bodies produce antibodies that are passed on to the foetus, which will protect the newborns during the first few months of life. The post ‘I Got My Tdap Immunisation To Protect My Baby From The Start’ appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Second Red-Bellied Piranha Caught In Klau River: Group
items.summary: Jejak Air Tawar announces the second catch of a red-bellied piranha (Pygocentrus nattereri) in Klau River in Raub, after a specimen was first discovered last August. Red-bellied piranha have razor-sharp teeth. DOF previously couldn't confirm a population. The post Second Red-Bellied Piranha Caught In Klau River: Group appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Philip Morris Visits Perlis Mufti, Touts ‘Safer’ Cigarettes
items.summary: Philip Morris Malaysia and economist Muhammed Abdul Khalid met with Perlis Mufti Dr Maza yesterday. The tobacco giant touted "safer" alternatives to conventional cigarettes. The mufti says a product can be considered halal if side effects are controllable. The post Philip Morris Visits Perlis Mufti, Touts ‘Safer’ Cigarettes appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Specialist Training In Malaysia: Time For An Honest Diagnosis And Meaningful Reform — Dr Vicknes Waran
items.summary: Every policy governing specialist training should be judged by one simple question: does it produce better specialists for the patients we serve? items.title: When We Become Medical Tourists — Dr Ng Kuo Chern
items.summary: If blunt and overly restrictive measures are imposed in the name of financial prudence, we risk hampering our ability to develop and extend our health care capabilities. For Malaysians with the means to travel, seeking treatment abroad becomes an option. The post When We Become Medical Tourists — Dr Ng Kuo Chern appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: How Sarawak Can Create A Specialised Aeromedical Service
items.summary: A Sarawakian doctor, who now practises in Australia, urges Sarawak to form its own specialised aeromedical service that isn't merely transport. A Sarawak FDS can be co-funded by state corporate groups. Aeromedical medicine should be a career pathway. The post How Sarawak Can Create A Specialised Aeromedical Service appeared first on CodeBlue .
